videos.caption: My AI app stack is a lot smaller than people expect. I don’t want 40 tools. I want a few tools that each earn their place. Midjourney is still useful when I want more stylized visuals. For organization, I keep things simple. Google Drive, Slack, and a small number of tools I already use every day. For automation, Zapier and Make are still two of the first places I look when I see repetitive work. The bigger lesson is this: your AI stack does not need to be huge. Pick the tool you think best with. Pick the tool you create with. Pick the tool where your work lives. Pick the tool that handles repetitive work. Then get good at connecting them.
